text:
morgan (new-hire): hey folks, quick onboarding q: I need to produce a weekly PDF of a Grafana dashboard for our product review and also schedule a weekly Datadog report that posts to #product-weekly. I can view dashboards but not seeing export options or schedule buttons. anyone set this up before?
eli (observability): welcome! quick answers: Grafana has a snapshot/export -> PDF plugin we use, but it requires either the Reporting plugin (licensed) or using headless chrome to print to PDF from a server with an embed token. Datadog scheduled reports are a separate feature under Dashboards -> Share -> Schedule Report and require the "reporting" role.
morgan (new-hire): I'm on the free/standard Grafana UI view. where do I request the plugin or permissions?
nina (devex): file an access request: https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests -> choose 'Grafana - Reporting/Export' (if you want infra to enable the export plugin for your team) or 'Grafana - Embed token' if you want to generate a one-off token and use our docs proxy to render a PDF. Include dashboard UID and intended recipients.
morgan (new-hire): is there a quick local workaround to get a PDF now for this week's meeting?
eli (observability): temp workaround: open the dashboard in kiosk mode and print to PDF from a headless browser. Example using puppeteer on your laptop:
```bash
node -e "const puppeteer=require('puppeteer');(async()=>{const b=await puppeteer.launch();const p=await b.newPage();await p.goto('https://grafana.redwood.company/d/UID/my-dashboard?orgId=1&kiosk=tv');await p.pdf({path:'dashboard.pdf',format:'A4'});await b.close();})();"
```
Note: if dashboard is behind auth you'll need an embed token or cookies.
morgan (new-hire): got it. for Datadog schedule, I don't see the Schedule Report option under Share. is that definitely a role?
eli (observability): yes the Schedule Report button is gated by the Datadog "reports" permission and by account-level feature toggles. If it's missing, either your role lacks reports or our org plan doesn't include scheduled reports for that workspace.
morgan (new-hire): how do I request the Datadog role?
nina (devex): access portal -> 'Datadog - Reporting role' and include workspace name + reason (weekly product review). Approvers often ask for a sample list of recipients to ensure no PII exposures.
morgan (new-hire): one more thing: I tried to create a Grafana snapshot (Share -> Snapshot) but got an error saying "Snapshot service disabled". is that intentional?
sam-infra: we disabled public snapshots for security reasons. If you need an internal snapshot for a scheduled report, request 'Grafana - Internal snapshot service' via the access portal and state who will access it. Alternative: use the docs proxy to generate a PDF on-demand and push to Confluence/Notion.
morgan (new-hire): submitted two requests: Grafana - Reporting/Export (#5255) and Datadog - Reporting role (#5256). also requested internal snapshot service (#5257) since the report needs to be shared with execs.
access-bot: Access requests #5255,#5256,#5257 received. Routing: infra/observability approvers. ETA: 2 business days for plugin enablement, 1 business day for role grants. Include justification if urgent.
morgan (new-hire): thanks! if infra approves, any tips on automating the weekly PDF generation?
eli (observability): we have a small cron job repo that uses the docs proxy + headless chrome to render PDFs and uploads to S3, then posts the S3 link to Slack. Ping me and I can share the repo and a template job.
morgan (new-hire): perfect, will ping you. appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
